offers.description: Ordered list of iap.offers record keys available in this placement; order determines offer priority.

items.description: Ordered list of iap.offers record keys available in this placement; order determines offer priority.

limits.description: Maximum offer uses per player in this placement; perSession is client-side, perDay is checked when ordering free offers.

perSession.description: Maximum offer uses in this placement per player in one game session; enforced by the client.

perDay.description: Maximum offer uses in this placement per player in a UTC day.
